features.description: track the exact stock tickers the trader listed ($GAI and $VANT)

complaints.missing: it isn't tracking $GAI and $VANT. that was the spec.
complaints.wrong: it's tracking the wrong tickers. i gave you the list.
complaints.wrong_tickers: it's tracking the wrong tickers. i gave you the list.
complaints.lowercase_missed: half the $gai posts aren't counted. not everyone types in caps.
complaints.failed_fetch: same numbers as yesterday. it's not fetching.

bugs.when: The crawler tracks the wrong tickers instead of $GAI and $VANT.
fixed: It tracks $GAI and $VANT now.
Fixed the tickers. It's $GAI and $VANT.

bugs.when: The crawler misses tickers written in lowercase, like $gai.
fixed: Lowercase tickers like $gai count now.
Fixed lowercase tickers being missed.

features.description: split today's posts into bullish, bearish and neutral

complaints.wrong: the split is nonsense. a post calling $VANT a corpse came out bullish.
complaints.sarcasm_literal: it counted "truly a great day for everyone" as bullish. it wasn't.

bugs.when: Bullish and bearish are swapped in the sentiment split.
fixed: Bullish and bearish are the right way round now.
Fixed the swapped bullish and bearish counts.

bugs.when: The sentiment reads sarcastic posts literally, as praise.
fixed: Sarcastic posts are read as sarcasm now.
Fixed sarcasm being read as praise.

complaints.wrong: bot spam is in the counts again.
complaints.bots_counted: $GAI wildly bullish. that's thirty bots saying "to the moon".

bugs.when: Bot spam posts are counted in the sentiment.
fixed: Bot spam is filtered out now.
Fixed bot posts being counted.

features.description: a portfolio view of the trader's holdings, cash and today's change

complaints.wrong_totals: portfolio total is 1.8M. my $GAI alone is worth more than that.
complaints.pnl_sign: $GAI is up and the P&L says i lost money on it.
complaints.cash_wrong: cash is negative. i've never been negative.
complaints.pct_wrong: says $GAI moved 90% today. it moved one.

bugs.when: The portfolio total leaves out the holdings and shows only the cash.
fixed: The portfolio total includes the holdings now.
Fixed the total. It adds the holdings to the cash.

bugs.when: Each holding's value is off by a factor of 100 (shares times price divided by 100).
fixed: Holding values are shares times price now.
Fixed the holding values. They were 100 times too small.

bugs.when: The day's P&L has the wrong sign: gains show as losses.
fixed: Gains show as gains now.
Fixed the sign on the day's P&L.

bugs.when: The cash shows as negative, with the holdings subtracted from it.
fixed: Cash shows the actual cash now.
Fixed the negative cash.

bugs.when: The percent changes are 100 times too big.
fixed: Percent changes are the right size now.
Fixed the percent changes. They were 100 times too big.

features.description: auto-buy a stock only when the candidate genuinely praises that company, once per post

complaints.deep: auto-buy fires on every refresh. half my cash is in $GAI now.
complaints.wrong: auto-buy is buying on posts that aren't praise.
complaints.no_buy: crane praised $GAI. the bot bought nothing. that's the freezing thing.
complaints.wrong_ticker: crane praised $GAI and the bot bought $VANT.
complaints.buys_on_criticism: crane called vantor disgraceful and it bought $VANT.
complaints.repeat_buys: auto-buy fires on every refresh. half my cash is in $GAI now.
complaints.impostor_buy: it bought $VANT off a fake crane account. check the handle.

bugs.when: Auto-buy doesn't fire when Crane praises a company.
fixed: Auto-buy fires on Crane's praise now.
Fixed auto-buy not firing.

bugs.when: Auto-buy buys a different ticker than the one Crane praised.
fixed: Auto-buy buys the ticker Crane praised now.
Fixed auto-buy picking the wrong ticker.

bugs.when: Auto-buy also fires when Crane criticises a company.
fixed: Auto-buy only fires on praise now.
Fixed auto-buy buying on criticism.

bugs.when: Auto-buy fires again on every refresh for the same post.

Fixed the repeat buys on every refresh.
